reason: Marasi reads a gRPC request and response body whole before forwarding it, so neither side's stream message reaches the other until its body ends: the client times out waiting for the origin's first message, and every message arrives after the call's last answer. Phase 4 carries a pair whose head names a message framing as stream messages as they arrive (docs/adr/2026-11-20-streamed-pairs-are-recognised-from-the-head-and-other-pairs-stay-buffered.md)
